remarks: Rare opportunity alert! Welcome to Winnipauk Village, the most desirable condominium complex in Norwalk. Within this exceptional community sits building R, the most sought-after section because R is uniquely positioned to provide a true private backyard experience. Among so many other stand-out features, R5 boasts an easy walk-out to your private bluestone patio with enchanting open space enveloped by mature privacy trees and lush landscaping. This entire home has been thoughtfully reimagined with the finest materials and meticulous craftsmanship, as the unit features an exquisite blend of modern sophistication and timeless comfort. The light-filled open-concept living and dining areas create an inviting ambiance, enhanced by artistically curated design elements that maximize space and aesthetic appeal. The kitchen has been completely renovated with brand-new stainless steel appliances: stove, refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave. Kohler sink, classic subway tile backsplash and brand new custom cabinetry adding style and functionality to make the space as beautiful as it is practical. Every inch of this home was thoughtfully designed to provide both luxury and efficiency. Bedroom has custom closet systems to maximize organization, built-ins, brand new sliders. Additional walk-in closet (46" x 60") was cleverly transformed into a versatile space, ideal for a tiny home office or nursery, providing an additional layer of functionality to this sophisticated home.
